title: A worker whose re-anchor leaves its reworded fact unlocated anchors it with a quote or reports it
goal: The worker role file's done bar says that when factdiff.py anchor reports a reworded or added fact of the item as unlocated, the worker anchors it with a quote the source holds (as ST-dfsfutx4 did) or names it in its report as unanchored. Found by the SP-3g3egfll close: ST-nfrimn67 and ST-diks4hle each left a reworded fact unlocated without following it (ST-gympyz6m).

run:
import sys
t=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('3. **Done bar.**');s=t[i:t.find('\n## ',i+3)] if i>=0 else ''
ok='unlocated' in s;print('3. **Done bar.**','names','unlocated',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
